Name: Konata's Buildings for Attack Otaku
Author: TheMajesticKonata
Description:
This mod currently changed what the farm houses look like each season.
I've been working on an overall content patch called Attack Otaku
I plan to have this as an overall game content patch

Interiors will change
Buildings will change
Seb has his bong back!
Shane will not be dragging this muddy feet thru his room in the house



and the biggest thing that I wanted that I look forward to releasing,
the entire valley will appear in japanese (game play will be in english of course)

[b]Next Update:[/b]
More building recolours (on farm)
